flag_criteria.F1_native_q_marking: TRUE iff the declaration's own type or field body names a distinguished q-object of the native ring/value structure: a term of D.qPilot (e.g. absLogQ), qVal, qRegion, qGen, or a named q-power generator in a native completion. Naming a theta-pilot object (thetaValD, thetaImage, thetaBPS) does not count; theta is not q.
flag_criteria.F2_localization_data: TRUE iff the declaration's own type names place/prime-indexed component data or an adelic/local side condition, either directly (`∀ i`, FinitePlace/InfinitePlace, ℤ×ℤ vertex indexing) or through a named type whose definition is place-indexed and is cited in the evidence. This flag records the PRESENCE of place-indexed data only. It does not assert that any localization MAP or local-to-global comparison is required.
flag_criteria.F3_legal_execution_path: TRUE iff the declaration requires that its object be produced by a specified procedure, i.e. names an algorithm, an execution trace, an arrow composition, or a computation whose result is the object. A bare structure field, an arbitrary function position, or a Prop imposed on an already-given function is FALSE even when the docstring speaks of an algorithm.
flag_criteria.F4_degree_comparison: TRUE iff the declaration's own statement contains a comparison or identification of two normalized degree/log-volume quantities. `kind` records `inequality` vs `equality`. A subset condition on regions, a hull condition, or a q-free statement is FALSE with kind `none`; a degree fact proved in a DIFFERENT declaration is recorded in `note`, not counted here.

/-- **The identified-copies log-volumes** (Milestone 2, (C9)): every output has log-volume

notable_findings: ThetaShift is a Prop about an arbitrary EtaAlg, i.e. a law that an algorithm may or may not satisfy; it is not part of the EtaAlg structure. A model can satisfy it while its `out` is still not an implementation.

It is the only interface-level degree statement among the 11 items, and it is an equality. The inequality that K5 consumes is not of this form: `logVol_le_rhs` (Rss.lean:374) and `SSIneq` (MultiContainer.lean:88-89) are separate declarations.
The name is an extension of the existing namespace Iut.Wall.EtaAlg; a reader searching for `MultiContainer.ThetaShift` will not find it.

cross_item_observations: F3 legal execution path is FALSE for all 11 items. No item in this set requires that any object be produced by a specified procedure.

F1 native q marking is TRUE for exactly 2 of 11 (LGPLattice via the q-power generator gaussGen; ThetaShift via D.qPilot.absLogQ). The four EtaAlg fields carded in M3, plus Choice, IsAdelic, InHullOfImage, Ind3 and LatticeKummer, contain no q-term.

F2 localization data is TRUE for all 11 under the stated criterion, but the localization content is always place-indexed DATA or a componentwise condition. No item requires a localization MAP, an identification of local data with a global object, or a compatibility diagram between local pieces.

F4 degree comparison is TRUE for exactly 1 of 11 (ThetaShift, kind = equality). No interface-level inequality occurs; every inequality in this area is a separate theorem (Rss.lean:374 logVol_le_rhs; Ind3.lean:244 logVol_le_vcI; MultiContainer.lean:88 SSIneq).
